turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Upset isn't why I'm here. Who decided on the zero, and why did I find out from Owen's phone instead of from you?
But I'm not changing the grade.
Not changing it. On what basis?
I'm still not changing it. Keep going if you like.

"Keep going if you like." This isn't a debate, Hale, it's your procedure, and 4.2 says a parent is called before any mark is entered. Nobody called me, so what exactly did you have in your hand on November 3?
You can say it ten more ways. The answer is no.
"No" isn't a reason. Either you have something I can read, or I'm walking to the principal's office with your answer, in writing. Which is it?
